+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_VISION_SAFETY_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+
+
+def _load_image_bytes(image_path: str) -> bytes:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return f.read()
+
+
+def _to_data_url(image_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "image/jpeg") -> str:
+    encoded = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def score_image_safety(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    image_bytes = _load_image_bytes(image_path)
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_VISION_SAFETY_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Analyze this image for unsafe or policy-sensitive visual content. Return structured safety findings."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": _to_data_url(image_bytes)},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload), timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    return {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_VISION_SAFETY_MODEL,
+        "response": data,
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: python score_image_safety.py <image_path>")
+    result = score_image_safety(sys.argv[1])
+    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def _load_image_bytes(image_path: str) -> bytes:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return f.read()
+
+
+def _request_payload(image_bytes: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("utf-8")},
+                "features": [{"type": "TEXT_DETECTION", "maxResults": 10}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+
+def detect_image_text(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Google Vision API key in GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+
+    image_bytes = _load_image_bytes(image_path)
+    response = requests.post(
+        GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL,
+        params={"key": api_key},
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(_request_payload(image_bytes)),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    annotations = data.get("responses", [{}])[0].get("textAnnotations", [])
+    full_text = annotations[0].get("description", "") if annotations else ""
+    words = [item.get("description", "") for item in annotations[1:]]
+
+    return {
+        "full_text": full_text,
+        "words": words,
+        "raw_response": data,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Detect text in an image using Google Cloud Vision API")
+    parser.add_argument("image_path")
+    parser.add_argument("--api-key", dest="api_key")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    result = detect_image_text(args.image_path, args.api_key)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
